name: Steamwheedle Cartel
summary: In its ports, the Steamwheedle Cartel welcomes Alliance and Horde alike, so long as their coin is genuine. This powerful goblin enterprise has hubs in Booty Bay, Ratchet, and Gadgetzan. Its trade reaches shipping, alchemy, salvaging, and mercenary contracts.

sections.title: A Profitable Neutrality
sections.body:
The Steamwheedle Cartel began beneath the earth in Undermine, the goblin capital. During the Second War, it backed the Old Horde with war machines, sappers, and naval engineering. When the war ended, its leaders judged that choosing sides cost more than it earned.

So the cartel turned to neutrality and spread across both continents, opening trade to Alliance and Horde alike. As tensions rise, its ports remain common ground. Anyone with gold can buy passage, store goods, or hire local specialists.

sections.title: Ports and Outposts
sections.body:
The Steamwheedle Cartel builds its influence around ports and frontier towns. In Stranglethorn Vale, Baron Revilgaz rules Booty Bay, a harbor fortified in the cliffs beside the Blackwater Raiders. Across the Great Sea, Chief Engineer Gazlowe directs Ratchet on the Barrens coast.

A deep-water ferry runs straight from Ratchet to Booty Bay. Gadgetzan lies deep in Tanaris, while Steamwheedle Port and outposts in Desolace, Azshara, and Stonetalon Mountains secure resources across the region.

sections.title: Rivals and Reavers
sections.body: Cutthroats threaten Steamwheedle trade at sea and on land. The Bloodsail Buccaneers menace Booty Bay's sea lanes, while Southsea Freebooters raid the coast near Ratchet. On land, the cartel fights its corporate rival, the Venture Company, over timber rights, oil fields, and shredder technology in Stonetalon and the Barrens. To keep order and enforce trade contracts, cartel barons hire passing mercenaries to settle disputes with extreme force.

faq.answer: The Steamwheedle Cartel is a neutral goblin trading enterprise based in Undermine. Its towns include Booty Bay, Ratchet, and Gadgetzan, where it offers banking, engineering, transport, and auction houses to every faction.

faq.q: Are the Steamwheedle goblins part of the Horde or Alliance?
faq.answer: Neither. The cartel keeps political neutrality and trades with both the Alliance and the Horde. It backed the Old Horde during the Second War, then ended its faction ties to pursue profit. Armed bruisers keep order in its towns.

faq.q: Which major cities belong to the Steamwheedle Cartel?
faq.answer: The cartel's principal towns are Booty Bay in southern Stranglethorn Vale, Ratchet on the eastern shore of the Barrens, Gadgetzan in Tanaris, and Everlook in Winterspring. It also keeps smaller hubs, including Steamwheedle Port, and isolated trading outposts.
The cartel is run from Undermine. Its towns answer to local bosses, including Baron Revilgaz in Booty Bay and Chief Engineer Gazlowe in Ratchet.

faq.q: Why are the Steamwheedle goblins enemies with the Venture Company?
faq.answer: The Venture Company is a rival goblin enterprise known for strip-mining and deforestation. The two groups fight over territorial concessions, industrial blueprints, and natural resources across Kalimdor and the Eastern Kingdoms.

faq.q: What happens if you fight inside a Steamwheedle port?
faq.answer: Armed goblin bruisers keep order in Steamwheedle towns. If you attack other travelers, guards may come after you; killing cartel guards or citizens harms your standing with the cartel.

angles.text: Ratchet and Gadgetzan are key places to find Goblin Engineering schematics, shredder parts, and experimental mechanical components.
As an Alliance traveler, you can use Steamwheedle ferries and desert outposts as waystations and flight paths through remote wilderness where the Horde is strong.
Gazlowe and his crew have long worked with the orcs of Durotar, but the cartel still expects payment for its services and keeps to neutrality.
Booty Bay and Ratchet's lawless fringes offer work for thieves, lockpicks, and covert contractors willing to fleece pirates and rivals.
